notes: Builds from the existing portable tree (npm run desktop:package).
The product version is NOT pinned here: it is read from apps/desktop/package.json at build time and passed to the installer as /DMyAppVersion, so there is exactly one version string.
Per-user install; no administrator elevation required.
The Inno AppId GUID is unchanged from the Jarvis Desktop builds, so an existing installation upgrades in place and keeps the user's data.
User data stays under %LOCALAPPDATA%\KarkeDikha\desktop — never packaged.
Ollama/local-only remains the default; OpenRouter stays paused.
